comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These can be obtained via:

Fishing/Collecting at sea (higher skill ranks and Casting Net ship skill may help increase the chances of this))
Sinking NPC ships
Besting NPCs in land/dungeon battles
Using Search/Collection/Procurement at landmarks
Your pet finding a piece while sailing at sea (rare)
Randomly given to you by NPC Shopkeepers and Marketkeepers when purchasing goods (rare)
Randomly given to you when updating your private farm in person, rather than at the bank
Found in East Asian dungeon treasure chests and/or clearing an EA dungeon boss floor (Fort San Domingo middle/lower seems to be the best source for SWMPs)

I've probably missed a few. As you can see, SWMPs come from just about everywhere in the game, with certain actions being more likely to yield them than others.
